# Heraldic Clouds Inc.

> Heraldic Clouds Inc. pursues a mission to democratize technology and ensure prosperety for all humanity through free, democratized, humane AI and pioneering AI governance solutions.

The company is committed to technology aligned with the values of humanity rather than the interests of elites; open-source software; Web3.0 and blockchain; privacy-respecting, anti-tracking apps; and distributed applications. Heraldic does not believe people’s data is gold and will never collect or sell it. Transparency is key to trust, and everything Heraldic builds is intended to serve humanity. The site has no affiliate storefront or third-party tracking.

## Pages

- [Heraldic home](https://www.heraldic.cloud/): Company overview, mission, privacy approach, and navigation.
- [Media](https://www.heraldic.cloud/media/): Three NVIDIA GTC conference poster images and an 18-image cloud desktop, graphics benchmark, and 3D mapping archive. No PDF downloads are provided.
- [Mise En Abyme (MEA)](https://www.heraldic.cloud/mea/): Mise En Abyme cloud desktop services, features, and technology.
- [MEA plain-text reference](https://www.heraldic.cloud/mea.md): Markdown version of the MEA services.

## Company and project context

- MEA stands for Mise En Abyme, a virtual cloud desktop service.
- Mise En Abyme blends software, hardware, and the web; streams games from the cloud; turns a smartphone into a desktop computer; features next-generation security; and uses IPv6 Internet addresses.
- The Heraldic site presents the company's mission to democratize technology and ensure prosperety for all humanity.
- Heraldic's services and goals include liberating technology through cloud computing, business automation, gaming cloud desktops, AI social media, and building AGI.
- Artem AI can explain Heraldic's commitments to humane AI, AI governance, open source, Web3.0, blockchain, privacy, anti-tracking, distributed apps, and transparency.
